exceptions.nrfLogTable: Only .nrf-log-table-wrap intentionally scrolls a wide log table; its wrapper must fit the page and expose the last column.
exceptions.scannerCanvas: Canvas, SVG plots and XR overlays may overlap their own scene. Ordinary headings, cards and actions remain checked.
exceptions.verticalScroll: Offscreen content is allowed when normal page scrolling exposes its controls; every enabled action must remain hit-testable.
exceptions.nativeInput: Single-line input text scrolls inside the native field; the field itself must fit. Native select popups are browser UI.
